tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents
The tenderer shall quote man power portion and material portion separately
The tenderer shall quote amount with respect to service charges for manpower portion for a period of 24 months, which shall be fixed for a period of 24 months
Tenderer shall quote the rates excluding GST

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency/Bidder should have provided Mechanized House Keeping Service in at least Two reputed Organizations (State/Central Govt./ PSU/Electrical Distribution Companies / Transmission Company) and Private limited company Provided 39 Nos of house keepers for a minimum continuous period of any Two year in last 5 (five) financial years . i.e., FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Annual Turnover shall not be less than the amount put to tender i.e Rs. 350.77 Lakhs in any two years of the previous five financial years (i.e. F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26). (Note: The turnover amount will be updated to the FY 2026-27 in which the tenders are invited. The Financial turnover of previous years will be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY 2026-27 in which the tenders are invited).
